title: Bajigur - Coffee and Coconut Milk with Toddy Palm Fruit
ldName: Bajigur - Coffee and Coconut Milk with Toddy Palm Fruit
ldKeywords: Coffee with coconut milk, palm sugar, and toddy palm fruit
ldIngredientsRaw: 200 gram toddy palm fruit (Indonesian: kolang kaling), thinly sliced
ldInstructionsRaw: Place coconut milk, coffee, palm sugar, and pandan leaves in a pot. Bring to a boil on to medium heat, stir frequently to prevent the coconut milk from curdling. Once it boils and the palm sugar has all dissolved, turn off heat.
Discard the pandan leaves, and strain into 4 serving glasses. Add some slices of toddy palm fruit to each glass. Topped with ice cubes if you prefer cold bajigur.
